question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A list of books
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Catalogue"** refers to a complete list of items, typically one in alphabetical or other systematic order, in particular. (सूची)

 
 
• **Example: **The library's **catalogue** is available online for easy access to the list of books.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the correct one-word substitute for** 'A list of books'** is **'Catalogue'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Lexicon **(शब्दकोश): The vocabulary of a person, language, or branch of knowledge.

 
 
• **Example:** The **lexicon** of medical terms can be quite challenging for a layperson to understand.
 
 
 
• **Manuscript **(पांडुलिपि ): A handwritten or typed document, especially a writer's composition, draft, or work before it is published.
 
 
• **Example: **The author submitted the** manuscript** of her novel to the publisher.
 
 
 
• **Bibliography** (ग्रंथ सूची): A list of the books referred to in a scholarly work, typically printed as an appendix.
 
 
• **Example:** The **bibliography** at the end of the research paper listed all the sources used by the author.
